kayla: FYI opened gh#5233 to tighten up function/tool-calling docs and fix failing anchors after the reorg. Main asks: pick a single recommended JSON shape, add tiny py/js SDK snippets, and sweep stale anchors. :wave:
rene: Link?
kayla: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233 1 anchor failures listed in the PR (old ids from pre-reorg headers).
otto: Do we have a preferred shape? Envelope/frame/packet all float around in history. I propose `action_bundle` — short, neutral, and distinct. It keeps metadata scoped.
rene: `action_bundle` SGTM. Add a tiny JSON Schema and a parse_fallback helper that accepts both legacy flat and new bundle shapes. Also call out nullable arrays (models sometimes return null for lists).
kayla: Draft schema in PR: {"type":"object","properties":{"action_bundle":{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"},"data":{"type":["object","array","null"]}},"required":["action"]}},"required":["action_bundle"]}.
otto: I'll add Node + Python snippet examples showing generate + parseActionBundleFallback() and push under docs/snippets/action_bundle.
docs-bot: Staging deploy: success  link-check job queued.
kayla: I'll run an anchor sweep (grep+replace) after otto pushes snippets and add a small link-check rule to ensure header ids are kebab-case without punctuation.
rene: Sounds good. Action items: otto -> snippets + parse shim; kayla -> anchor sweep + link-check tweak; rene -> review + merge after link-check green.
ott0: tiny typo in my name above :D
oto: pushed snippets, PR updated.
